correctness.rationale: In the uniform independent-parent recursive tree, conditioning on the whole labeled forest of younger vertices fixes internal child-parent edges and the independent events that each component root chooses one of the i old labels; given that, choices of old parent are independent uniform. Each young component contributes its size to S_i-1 with Bernoulli(1/i), proving the product conditional PGF for all n and i, including i=1 and i=n. Each S_j,j>i is measurable from the younger forest; tower property gives E[S_i|later sizes]=n/i and pairwise zero covariances. Two-color Pólya urn yields beta-binomial variance n(n-i)(i-1)/(i^2(i+1)). Double counting ancestors gives the weighted path mean/variance; n=4 joint S2=3,S3=2 witness disproves independence. Independent exhaustive parent enumeration n=2..7 checked complete forest-stratum PGFs and mixed moments, not just marginals. All tree files and blobs reconstructed.
residual_risks: Uniform random recursive trees with independent uniform older parents; weights deterministic or exogenous.
Conditional independence applies to root-attachment indicators, never to all subtree sizes; finite enumeration is supplementary.
